text: I put the full breakdown on screen — the pre-Modal orchestration, the four passes inside Modal, and the post-processing. The key gotcha to remember: Pass 1 is the heaviest hit at strength 0.92 and that's where the LoRA style personality really lands, but ControlNet depth is intentionally skipped there because of a fal pipeline-load workaround. And the whole thing is synchronous from the route's perspective — Next.js just waits on the Modal webhook for up to 5 minutes.
